summary: This document outlines the requirements for training a Deep Q-Network (DQN) agent on Ms. Pac-Man. The student must select three hyperparameters, train the agent, and submit a comprehensive report detailing the process, results, and limitations of the trained agent.
key_facts: Choose three hyperparameters: Exploration, Episodes, and Learning rate.
Exploration ranges from 0 to 1; 0.20 means about 20% of training moves are random after warm-up.
Episodes must be a positive whole number; 100 is the notebook's starting value.
Learning rate dictates the size of each update; 0.0001 is a suggested starting point.
Evaluation must use the same settings: five seeds, 5% exploration, and time limit before/after training.
The submission requires a public GitHub repository URL containing the executed notebook and evidence in its README.
Report all five before/after evaluation scores and their means.
